## Context

`sample.txt` currently holds four lines (`alpha`, `bravo`, `charlie`, `delta`) and is used in this session as a small test fixture. The request is to extend it with one more line containing the word `echo`, continuing the NATO-alphabet sequence.

Append a single line `echo` to the end of `/tmp/wterm-capture/cc/proj/sample.txt`, preserving the existing four lines and the trailing newline. Verify with `cat sample.txt` (expect five lines ending in `echo`) and `wc -l sample.txt` (expect `5`).
